activity_statements.statement: designs and manufactures CPUs, GPUs, and AI accelerators for data centers, PCs, and edge computing, running on approximately 70% of the world's PCs
operates Intel Foundry, the only US-headquartered leading-edge chip fabrication facility, providing full-stack design, manufacturing, and advanced packaging services
builds AI platforms spanning processors, accelerators, and software across cloud, enterprise, and edge on open ecosystems for the Intelligence Era
invests in a €5 billion expansion of semiconductor manufacturing in Europe to broaden the European semiconductor supply chain
holds 70,000+ Intel-owned patent assets and targets 1 trillion transistors on a single device by 2030
collaborates with Google Cloud to scale agentic AI across enterprise business functions using Intel silicon
designs handheld gaming processors (Arc G-Series) for portable gaming devices, extending silicon reach beyond PC and data center

segments.name: Intel Products (Client Computing, Data Center & AI, Network & Edge)

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Semiconductor Manufacturing' is accurate but underweights Intel's growing identity as a foundry-for-hire (Intel Foundry) competing directly with TSMC and Samsung for third-party chip orders — a structural shift that makes Intel simultaneously a chip designer, a mass manufacturer, and a contract fabricator.
